R1_fixed_token.mechanism: CORRECTION_TOKENS is consulted by checkContradiction (B) to REJECT. `fixed` is ambiguous between REPAIRED and ATTACHED, so an asserted `is fixed` predicated of a SIGN deletes a correct high-consequence ACTIVE finding.
R1_fixed_token.rule: 35.1 -- a vocabulary used to REJECT must be unambiguous; a vocabulary used to ADMIT may be permissive
R1_fixed_token.precedent: L3-2e removed bare `removed` from the rejection path for this exact reason (UNAMBIGUOUS_SERVICE_WITHDRAWAL)
